co2.guideText:
Sustainability and LCA (Life Cycle Assessment)

Choosing the right piping system has a significant impact on the carbon footprint of a building or industrial facility. The K-Aqua CO2 Calculator provides a comprehensive Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) in accordance with EN 15804 standards. This analysis covers the entire lifecycle: from raw material extraction and product manufacturing (Phases A1-A3) to transport and installation (Phases A4-A5), the use phase (Phase B), and end-of-life (Phase C).

Compared to traditional metal pipes like copper or steel, K-Aqua's PP-R and PPRCT pipes boast a much more favorable environmental footprint. The lower energy required for plastic extrusion and the significantly reduced weight drastically lower CO2 emissions during production and transport. Furthermore, the mirror-smooth inner surface (roughness of just 0.007 mm) ensures extremely low flow resistance. According to the Darcy-Weisbach equation, this means circulation pumps require significantly less energy (electricity) to move fluids through the system.

Particularly during the use phase (Phase B), which for piping systems often lasts 50 years or longer, these energy savings translate into massive CO2 and cost reductions (Total Cost of Ownership, TCO). Even at the end of its lifespan (Phase C), polypropylene offers environmental benefits, as it is 100% recyclable and can be reused in a circular economy (Module D). Use this calculator to accurately and transparently quantify the ecological and economic savings potential of your K-Aqua project.

faqs.q: Is the project request subject to a fee?
faqs.a: No, the use of this tool and the subsequent preparation of an offer by our sales team are completely free of charge and non-binding for you.

faqs.q: What happens after the request is sent?
faqs.a: Your request is sent directly to our internal sales team. A personal contact person will get in touch with you within 24 hours to clarify any open questions or present a tailored offer.

faqs.q: Can I also make a request as a private individual?
faqs.a: K Aqua is primarily aimed at wholesalers, planners, and professional installers in the B2B sector. We are happy to refer private customers to our regional specialist partners.

Your inputs are not stored on the server but transferred directly to your email program, from where you can securely send the request to us. We treat your data strictly confidential according to current GDPR guidelines.
